title: When no parts qualify, no totals row is shown
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The filters can be set so that no part qualifies (for example, a part search matching nothing).
custom_steps:
1. Apply a filter or search that leaves no qualifying part.
2. Look at the bottom of the data area.
custom_expected: 1. The no-data message shows instead of rows and NO totals row is shown.
